metric_definitions.top_5_label_coverage: Fraction of each method's top five candidates with a provisional 0/1 label.
metric_definitions.conditional_precision_at_5_on_reviewed: Relevant labelled candidates divided by labelled candidates in top five; excludes unreviewed candidates and must be read with coverage.
metric_definitions.precision_at_5_lower_bound: Confirmed relevant candidates divided by five; treats unreviewed top-five candidates as not yet confirmed relevant.
metric_definitions.precision_at_5_upper_bound: Confirmed relevant plus unreviewed top-five candidates divided by five; assumes all unreviewed top-five candidates are relevant.
metric_definitions.known_label_pooled_recall_at_5: Confirmed relevant top-five results divided by confirmed relevant candidates in the reviewed portion of the pooled candidate set. Not full-corpus recall.
metric_definitions.confirmed_mrr_at_5_lower_bound: Reciprocal rank of first confirmed relevant candidate in top five, or zero if none is confirmed; unreviewed candidates may hide an earlier relevant result.

caution: All labels currently originate from AI suggestions; 39 rows marked NEEDS_HUMAN_REVIEW remain unjudged. These metrics are preliminary diagnostics only, not human-verified benchmark results and not suitable as claims of final retrieval performance.
scope_note: Recall is measured only against the AI-labelled subset of the judged union candidate pool, not the complete 1,570-ticket historical corpus.
